latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at ca29960f5cec21270ccd6b964ca02f0d2f33c899 -->

## What's Changed
### Exciting New Features ✨
* feat(query): support create iceberg table with partition and properties by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17812
* feat(query): support alter table/database refresh cache by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17841
* feat(query): variant support extension types(Decimal, Binary, Date, Timestamp, Interval) by @b41sh in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17835
* feat: Add sampled trace support by @Xuanwo in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17850
* feat: unload preserve order if the source is ordered. by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17864
* feat(optimizer): part support decorrelating correlated subqueries in join conditions by @forsaken628 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17871
* feat(cluster): support fuzzy match for warehouse unassign node by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17877
* feat(meta-client-semaphore): generate semaphore sequence using timestamps to reduce conflicts by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17878
* feat(query): atomic workload group metadata management by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17880
* feat(query): support manage query workload through sql by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17881
* feat(query): iceberg data cache by @sundy-li in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17787
* feat: impl `NgramIndex` for `FuseTable`, improve like query performance by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17852
* chore: `VirtualColumn` Bind by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17862
* feat: support using fragment forest to execute additional broadcast operations. by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17872
* feat: new table option `enable_auto_vacuum` by @dantengsky in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17884
* feat: new settings `data_retention_num_snapshots_to_keep` by @dantengsky in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17893
* feat(meta-service): add initialization complete flag for watch by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17900
* fix: avoid excessive concurrency in row fetch by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17885
* feat(query): Support `fuse_virtual_column` function to show virtual column size by @b41sh in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17910
* feat(base): allow exceeded  memory limit if no workload by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17785
* feat: Re-introduce Streaming Load API by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17921
* feat(query): support unset quota for workload group by @zhang2014 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17924
* feat: Supports reading table data from Iceberg ORC by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17898
* feat(parse): Simplify the matching pattern when parse function, avoid exponential backtracking by @KKould in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17942
* feat(meta-client): add `watch_with_initialization()` method by @drmingdrmer in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17944
* feat: support async function for merge not match clause by @SkyFan2002 in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17941
* feat(query): UserOption add workload_group by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17913
* feat(query): Independent system/information_schema database in different catalogs by @TCeason in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17863
* feat: support select from AVRO files. by @youngsofun in https://github.com/databendlabs/databend/pull/17953
* feat(query): support show
